benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, open the Swiggy app or website and log in to your account. Discover the latest dining and order-in deals, pick your desired items or restaurants, and apply the offer at payment. Settle your bill using your HDFC Business Regalia credit card to enjoy attractive cashback and discounts.
